name: adw
description: Spec-driven agentic development workflow for Python backends. Ships the house-style skill catalog (architecture, conventions, python-style, domain-model, domain-ports, application, infra-persistence, infra-integration, restapi, testing-unit, testing-integration, and two authoring meta-skills); the four roles of the change cycle as subagents (test-author, test-review, implementer, evaluator); three cycle commands (spec, build, accept) plus commit; and the Markdown templates those commands fill (living spec, delta spec, criteria checklist, verdict) with a Makefile carrying the definition of green.
